facts: Centrepiece visitor attraction in Bundaberg Botanic Gardens, built as a tribute to aviator Bert Hinkler
Displays memorabilia, interactive exhibits, flight simulators and historic aircraft covering his life; building designed to represent an aircraft wing
Admission includes entry to Hinkler House, his English home relocated brick by brick from Southampton in 1983
Allow 1-1.5 hours for the Hall and House
Hinkler flew first solo England-Australia, Feb 1928

cost.note: Adult $27 (child $18, senior $21); includes Hinkler House; combined ticket with Fairymead House and Historical Museum exists. Council page.

facts: Home of Bundaberg Ginger Beer, 147 Bargara Road, Bundaberg
Guided tasting of up to 15 Bundaberg brews plus self-guided gallery tour about brewing history (55+ years)
Adult ticket includes a mixed 6-pack
